calls.reason: Framed as an argument, and Microsoft's Q4 capex disclosure has no split by customer. The Anthropic-AWS deal shows dedicated capacity but no share of total capex.
Conditional forecast with no deadline. Amazon gives only an annualized AI revenue figure, and there is no data on cumulative returns from AI investment.
An 'I believe' forecast with no repayment horizon. The only evidence is a CoreWeave note maturing in 2033, with no default or write-off data.
Mixed evidence: Cast AI's 5% GPU use measures idle paid capacity, not unsold supply, and Microsoft says demand exceeds capacity. Neither is a representative market measure.
'Pathetic' has no threshold. Alphabet reports growing paid Gemini usage, and no source breaks out the AI revenue left after excluding the labs for all three companies.
Jefferies puts the labs at large shares of Google Cloud and Azure but only about 6% of AWS, with no customer rankings. Anthropic's financing warning doesn't show it can't pay.
